raw_record.question_text: Maria switches the lights on and off according to the given plan. For how many minutes in total are there exactly two lights on at the same time?

method.method_draft: Read the timeline bars in the image: Light 1 is on from 1–5 and 6–9 minutes, Light 2 from 2–6 and 7–12 minutes, and Light 3 from 0–3, 5–8, and 10–12 minutes. Use all switch times as breakpoints: 0,1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,12. For each interval between consecutive breakpoints, count how many of the three light bars cover it. The intervals with exactly two lights on are 1–2, 3–5, 5–6, 6–7, 8–9, and 10–12. Add their lengths: 1+2+1+1+1+2 = 8 minutes.
